summary: Massachusetts-built c.1915 lookout on Berlin Mountain (Rensselaer Co., NY); moved to Brodie Mountain, Hancock, MA in 1923; only footings remain on the summit.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts Brodie entry sits under a Hancock, Berkshire County heading, while Wikipedia places the Berlin Mountain summit in Rensselaer County, New York. The brief's Rensselaer County is kept for the Berlin summit, and the Brodie site is described as Hancock, Massachusetts.

sources.title: Hancock Fire Tower, Brodie Mt MA

notes_for_editor: The brief's 'gone' status is right for the Berlin Mountain site: the tower moved in 1923 and only footings remain. The Brodie (Hancock, MA) status is unresolved. Forest Lookouts lists a 1967 tower and a 2009 tubular steel tower at Brodie Mountain, while the 2026 Trailspotting guide describes a former tower with its cabin on East Mountain now carrying radio gear; the sources do not say whether the 1923 structure survives. The 1952 notice (returned to service) and the 1954 item (closed since before WWII) conflict; both are cited. The 1915 to 1923 history rests mainly on Wikipedia, which cites a source we could not open. Facebook posts from the Massachusetts FFLA chapter (including one saying the Brodie tower had not been staffed since 1972) appeared in search but were not readable from the cache, so they are not cited.
